content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the šiauliai district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property in a divorce case the movable and immovable property will be divided equally between the two parties credit obligations and leasing contracts will be considered joint responsibilities while personal debts will be recognized as their own the legal text discusses three articles from the civil code related to matrimonial property the case involves two parties referred to as the applicant and the defendant who have requested the dissolution of the marriage custody of their minor daughter and financial support the court will consider evidence and arguments to make a decision on property division and financial obligations taking into account the best interests of the children the court will determine the appropriate division of property and financial responsibilities based on the evidence and applicable laws the marriage between av and vv is being dissolved with each party awarded personal property certain claims and counterclaims related to vehicle ownership were dismissed and the parties are responsible for paying the costs of the proceedings
